description: This file contains implementation of the Service plugin for the WPEFramework, including request handling, service notifications, file serving, and network interface utilities.

classes.name: PluginHost::Request
classes.description: Represents a web request within the plugin host, managing request state and associated service.

classes.name: IShell::Job
classes.description: Factory method for creating shell jobs.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Provides web service functionalities including notification, file serving, and request validation.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration utilities for network interface selection.

methods.name: PluginHost::Request::Clear
methods.description: Resets the request state and releases the associated service.

methods.name: PluginHost::Request::Service
methods.description: Sets the service state based on error code and service validity.

methods.name: IShell::Job::Create
methods.description: Creates a new shell job with specified shell, state, and reason.

methods.name: Service::Notification
methods.description: Sends a notification message to all registered channels.

methods.name: Service::FileToServe
methods.description: Serves a file over HTTP, with support for default index and safe path validation.

methods.name: Service::IsWebServerRequest
methods.description: Checks if a URL segment matches the web server's configured prefix.

methods.name: Config::IPV4UnicastNode
methods.description: Determines the IPv4 unicast node ID for a given network interface name.
